verdict.rationale: The API docs show Issuing `Card` objects (physical or virtual) created through an API call, with a test/simulation environment before going live and a vendor claim of going "from integration to live cards in minutes, not months" with no setup fees. However, a cardholder object must be created first, and nothing in the pack shows PAN, CVV, and expiry being retrievable programmatically at issuance. Older community posts also describe access as invitation-only, sent in rolling batches, which complicates the self-serve claim even though they are dated. Missing for 10: evidence of programmatic PAN/CVV/expiry retrieval, confirmation of a true single-call flow without a separate cardholder step, independent corroboration of current self-serve live access without approval or sales.
